member.name: M:VilogLDC.Form1.RebrandDeviceNameText(System.String)
member.summary: Cosmetic rebrand shared by every serial link: hides the physical device brand name ("DRAGINO") behind "BAVITECH" before text reaches the user. No reverse mapping exists for this one (unlike AT+/VILOG_), so it's safe to apply unconditionally on any inbound text.

member.name: M:VilogLDC.Form1.RebrandLoggerText(System.String)
member.summary: Cosmetic rebrand for SerialPort1 (logger/config link, feeds RichTextBox2/4): "AT+" -> "VILOG_" (uppercase, this link's convention) plus the shared DRAGINO -> BAVITECH device-name rebrand.

member.name: M:VilogLDC.Form1.RebrandDebugText(System.String)
member.summary: Cosmetic rebrand for SerialPort2 (secondary/local debug link, feeds RichTextBox3): "AT+" -> "Vilog_" (mixed-case, this link's convention). Reversed on send via RichTextBox1.Text.Replace("Vilog_", "AT+") - keep this spelling in sync with that reverse mapping.
